name: dsr-web-app
description: Daily Status Report (DSR) tracker — per-employee login, project/activity time capture, Excel export for dashboards and project costing. Runs as a Node server, or on Vercel with Vercel Postgres or Turso.

comments.overrides: exceljs 4.4.0 pins uuid ^8.3.0, which carries GHSA-w5hq-g745-h8pq. ExcelJS only calls uuid.v4() with no arguments so the app is not exposed, but we force the patched release rather than downgrade exceljs to 3.x.
